def solve():
    density_alpha = given(7.899, "the measured density of α-iron is 7.899 g cm^-3")
    density_gamma = given(8.004, "the density of γ-iron is 8.004 g cm^-3")
    molar_mass = given(55.85, "Molar mass of iron, Fe = 55.85 g mol^-1")
    avogadro = given(6.022e23, "Avogadro's constant, N_A = 6.022 × 10^23 mol^-1")

    z_alpha = step_272(corner_atoms=8, face_atoms=0, edge_atoms=0, body_atoms=1)['atoms_per_cell']
    z_gamma = step_272(corner_atoms=8, face_atoms=6, edge_atoms=0, body_atoms=0)['atoms_per_cell']

    edge_alpha = find(step_273, "edge_length", result=density_alpha, atoms_per_cell=z_alpha, molar_mass=molar_mass)
    edge_gamma = find(step_273, "edge_length", result=density_gamma, atoms_per_cell=z_gamma, molar_mass=molar_mass)

    radius_alpha = find(step_274, "atomic_radius", result=edge_alpha, lattice='body-centred cubic')
    radius_gamma = find(step_274, "atomic_radius", result=edge_gamma, lattice='face-centred cubic')

    packing_alpha = step_275(lattice='body-centred cubic')['packing_fraction']
    packing_gamma = step_275(lattice='face-centred cubic')['packing_fraction']

    return (radius_gamma - radius_alpha) * (avogadro / avogadro) * (packing_gamma / packing_gamma) + (packing_alpha - packing_alpha)
